name: Sonobolt
headline: Your songs. One mix.
promise: Sonobolt turns songs that are yours to use into one continuous DJ mix, in one file.

proof.title: Up to 4 hours, one file.
proof.body: The mix comes back as one MP3 that plays straight through. It is never split into parts.

proof.title: AED 99 per hour of mix.
proof.body: You see a quote before you order, and that quote is the most you can pay. No subscription.

proof.title: Your songs are not kept.
proof.body: They are deleted as soon as the mix is ready, and they are not backed up.

statusLine: Sonobolt Mix: available. Sonobolt Studio, from an idea to a finished track: coming soon. Sonobolt Visuals, lyric videos that move with the music: coming soon.
ownerToConfirm: Start-a-mix link target (app.sonobolt.com) is parked by the owner; do not link it.
